from common import *
import gzip

def main():
    save_source(__file__);harness('check')
    import numpy as np,pandas as pd,qlib
    from backtest.scripts.train.train_regime_arm import frame_signature
    qlib.init(provider_uri=str(PROVIDER),region='cn',kernels=1)
    from qlib.data import D
    dates=pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(pd.read_csv(DATES,comment='#')['date']))
    lm=read(OLD_LABEL);prep=read(PRIOR/'docs/prepared-labels.json')
    original=[];changed=[]
    for b in prep['horizons']['20']['blocks']:
        oldp=OLD_LABEL.parent/lm['blocks'][str(b['year'])]['path'];check({**lm['blocks'][str(b['year'])],'path':str(oldp)})
        check(b);a,bnew=pd.read_pickle(oldp),pd.read_pickle(ROOT/b['path'])
        assert a.index.equals(bnew.index) and np.array_equal(a.isna(),bnew.isna())
        keep=a.index.get_level_values('datetime').isin(dates)
        original.append(a.loc[keep].dropna());changed.append(bnew.loc[keep].dropna())
    old=pd.concat(original);new=pd.concat(changed);del original,changed
    assert old.index.equals(new.index)
    assert len(new)==5448963
    assert np.count_nonzero(old.to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)!=new.to_numpy(dtype=np.float32))==106
    # Materialize the current raw target on the exact legacy eligible universe first.
    raw=D.features(D.instruments('all'),['Ref($close,-21)/Ref($close,-1)-1'],start_time='2004-01-02',end_time='2020-07-31').iloc[:,0]
    raw.index=raw.index.set_names(['instrument','datetime']);raw=raw.swaplevel().sort_index().reindex(new.index)
    assert np.isfinite(raw.to_numpy()).all()
    reproduced=(raw.groupby(level='datetime').rank(pct=True)-.5)*3.46
    assert np.array_equal(reproduced.to_numpy(dtype=np.float32),new.to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)),'raw snapshot does not reproduce current labels'
    del reproduced
    source_records=[]
    for p in sorted(PROVIDER.rglob('*')):
        if p.is_file():source_records.append(fingerprint(p))
    with gzip.open(BASE/'docs/provider-inputs.json.gz','wt') as f:json.dump({'root':str(PROVIDER),'files':source_records},f)
    checks={'original_changes':106,'training_rows':len(new),'exact_raw_rank_reproduction':True,'source_manifests':[fingerprint(FEATURE),fingerprint(OLD_LABEL),fingerprint(VALID)],'provider_files':len(source_records),'provider_inventory':fingerprint(BASE/'docs/provider-inputs.json.gz'),'inputs':{},'variants':{},'checks':[]}
    for tag,s in [('control_new',new),('control_old',old)]:
        out=BASE/'data'/f'{tag}.pkl';s.to_pickle(out);checks['inputs'][tag]=fingerprint(out)
    mu=float(new.astype(np.float32).astype(np.float64).mean());sd=float(new.astype(np.float32).astype(np.float64).std(ddof=0))
    for name in VARIANTS:
        n=10 if name=='quantile10' else 5
        if name=='width5':
            lo=raw.groupby(level='datetime').transform('min');hi=raw.groupby(level='datetime').transform('max')
            width=(hi-lo).to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
            # right-closed equal-width intervals, neutral middle on a constant day.
            g=np.full(len(raw),2,dtype=np.int8);varied=width>0
            scaled=(raw.to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)[varied]-lo.to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)[varied])/width[varied]
            g[varied]=np.clip(np.ceil(scaled*5)-1,0,4).astype(np.int8)
            groups=pd.Series(g,index=new.index);og=None
        else:groups=grade(new,name);og=grade(old,name)
        mean=float(groups.mean());stdev=float(groups.std(ddof=0));assert stdev>0
        scale=sd/stdev;offset=mu-scale*mean
        y=(groups.astype(float)*scale+offset).astype(np.float32);y.name='LABEL0'
        out=BASE/'data'/f'{name}-new.pkl';y.to_pickle(out)
        summary={'bins':n,'scale':scale,'offset':offset,'scores':[i*scale+offset for i in range(n)],'new':fingerprint(out),'new_signature':frame_signature(y),'counts':[int((groups==i).sum()) for i in range(n)],'target_mean':mu,'target_std':sd,'actual_mean':float(y.astype(float).mean()),'actual_std':float(y.astype(float).std(ddof=0)),'rms_error_to_continuous':float(np.sqrt(np.mean((y.to_numpy(dtype=float)-new.to_numpy(dtype=float))**2))),'old':None}
        assert abs(summary['actual_std']-sd)<1e-6
        assert abs(summary['actual_mean']-mu)<1e-6
        if og is not None:
            oy=(og.astype(float)*scale+offset).astype(np.float32);oy.name='LABEL0'
            out=BASE/'data'/f'{name}-old.pkl';oy.to_pickle(out)
            summary.update(old=fingerprint(out),old_signature=frame_signature(oy),membership_changes=int((groups!=og).sum()),encoded_changes=int((y!=oy).sum()),paired_fits_needed=not np.array_equal(y,oy))
            assert summary['membership_changes']==summary['encoded_changes']==1
        else:summary['sensitivity_limitation']='Frozen old raw H20 return magnitudes unavailable; no reconstructed106-change width comparison.'
        daily=groups.groupby(level='datetime').value_counts(normalize=True)
        summary['daily_max_bin_share']={'median':float(daily.groupby(level='datetime').max().median()),'max':float(daily.groupby(level='datetime').max().max())}
        checks['variants'][name]=summary
        print(name,summary['counts'],'changed',summary.get('encoded_changes'),flush=True)
    # Quantile boundaries and ties are tested using exact attainable midranks.
    idx=pd.MultiIndex.from_product([pd.to_datetime(['2010-01-04']),list('abcdefghij')],names=['datetime','instrument'])
    values=pd.Series((np.arange(1,11)/10-.5)*3.46,index=idx)
    assert grade(values,'quantile5').tolist()==[0,0,1,1,2,2,3,3,4,4]
    values.iloc[1:3]=(.25-.5)*3.46
    assert grade(values,'quantile5').iloc[1]==grade(values,'quantile5').iloc[2]
    checks['checks']=['sourceSHA and5448963exact indices','106 original float32differences','rawH20 ranks reproduce current target exactly','rank bin boundary and tie checks','training-only affine mean/std match','same affine encoding across paired sources','no reranking after grading']
    write(BASE/'configs/prepared-inputs.json',checks)
    st=read(PROGRESS);st['status']='prepared';st['prepared_inputs']=fingerprint(BASE/'configs/prepared-inputs.json');write(PROGRESS,st)
    print('Prepared labels; zero model fits.',flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':main()
